text.p: DuPont Co said directors Wednesday increased the quarterly dividend 11 percent, declaring a second quarter payment of $0.63 per share, payable June 12 to stockholders of record May 15.

The new dividend, which compares to the $0.57 cents paid in the first quarter, will be equal to $0.315 per share following the two-for-one stock split approved by shareholders when they voted an increase in the number of authorized common shares at Wednesday's annual meeting.

DuPont's stock was showing fractional losses from Tuesday's 107 close on turnover of three-quarters of a million shares in midafternoon trading. The stock opened higher and gained nearly a point in early trading after the increased dividend was announced.
The company said the split will be implemented with the distribution of one additional share on June 12 for each share of common stock held of record on May 15.

"The increase in the dividend is in line with our objective of providing our shareholders with a competitive annual return and coupled with the stock split, underscores the board's confidence in the future course of the business," said chief executive John A. Krol.

The company said unchanged quarterly dividends of $1.125 per share on the $4.50 series preferred stock and $0.875 per share on the $3.50 series preferred stock also were declared, both payable July 25, to stockholders of record July 10.
